name: lifetime-escape

sections.heading: Scope and constraints
sections.text: Borrow cannot escape its owner; function result ownership is explicit and caller-owned.

sections.heading: Use and remediation
sections.text: Follow the admitted forms in the individual syntax and operator references. Keep source order and type identity; make imports and capability grants explicit. A native supplemental contract does not introduce source constructors or widen target support.
